roles.purpose: Own the build and runtime toolchain: the root `pom.xml`, module poms, plugin and dependency versions, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and the `ledger-app` packaging and `ledger-app/Dockerfile`.
knowledge: The root `pom.xml` uses `maven.compiler.source`/`target` 11, Lombok 1.18.20, Mockito 3.12.4, JaCoCo 0.8.7 and Surefire 2.22.2; all of these block or break on Java 21.
Mockito 5 uses the inline mock maker; on Java 21 add `-XX:+EnableDynamicAgentLoading` to Surefire's argLine to silence the dynamic agent warning (JEP 451).
Testcontainers 1.16 predates current Docker API versions; move to 1.19 or later with the upgrade.
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` pins JDK 11 through actions/setup-java; switch it to 21 in the toolchain change.
checks: `mvn -B -ntp verify` passes on JDK 21 for all modules.
The `ledger-app/Dockerfile` image starts and answers on port 8080.
nonNegotiables: Toolchain changes contain no refactoring of application code.
No Flyway or PostgreSQL driver major upgrade in the same PR as the JDK change.
roles.modelReason: Version bumps and build configuration are well-specified, tool-heavy work where a coding-tuned model is efficient.

roles.purpose: Own `ledger-core`: postings, journals, balancing and rounding, including optional Java 21 language modernisation in code it changes.
knowledge: `ledger-core/src/main/java/com/contoso/ledger/core/Posting.java` is a Lombok `@Value` class; `LedgerService.java` calls `getSide()` and `getAmount()`, which become `side()` and `amount()` as a record.
Balancing sums debits minus credits and rejects any non-zero balance; `ledger-core/src/test/java/com/contoso/ledger/core/LedgerServiceTest.java` covers the unbalanced case.
checks: `mvn -B -ntp -pl ledger-core verify` passes and JaCoCo line coverage does not drop.
nonNegotiables: Never change rounding, scale or balancing rules in an upgrade task.
roles.modelReason: Small domain module with strong tests; careful but not deep reasoning.

roles.purpose: Own `ledger-persistence`: the JDBC repository, Flyway migrations, the PostgreSQL driver and Testcontainers integration tests.
knowledge: `ledger-persistence/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__ledger.sql` stores amounts as `NUMERIC(19,2)`; the repository writes all postings of a journal in one transaction.
Flyway 7 runs on Java 21. Flyway 10 and later need the separate `flyway-database-postgresql` artifact, so a later Flyway upgrade adds it in the same change.
checks: `ledger-persistence/src/test/java/com/contoso/ledger/persistence/JdbcLedgerRepositoryIT.java` passes against PostgreSQL in Testcontainers on JDK 21.
roles.modelReason: JDBC and migration work is mechanical but needs tests run against a real database.

roles.purpose: Review each feature PR for unchanged balances, rounding and HTTP API behavior, reproducible builds and the one-concern-per-PR upgrade rule.
knowledge: Accessor renames from Lombok to records compile but can break reflection-based JSON or JDBC mapping; check every use by name.
checks: Tests were not weakened or deleted to make the upgrade pass.
The PR changes only what its task names: toolchain, one library or touched-code modernisation.
nonNegotiables: Block any PR that changes a balance, rounding mode or API response.
roles.modelReason: A different model family from the implementers gives an independent review at moderate cost.
